incidents.name: 98Token swap helper unprotected swapTokensForTokens()
incidents.notes: The 98 swap contract's public swapTokensForTokens(address[],uint256,uint256,address) spends the contract's own token balance and sends the proceeds to a caller-supplied recipient, so the attacker drained its entire 98 holding to itself.

sources.ref: onchain review: victim 0xB040D88e61EA79a1289507d56938a6AD9955349C created 2025-01-03T07:23:26Z by 0x0d06757892d3a5772b23bdb6198cb2613419fd94, which is not the attack-tx sender 0x67a5f6bd9f8763c7e6c4ea0b54d1b14b9e5ee7e2; 0 EIP-1967 Upgraded events on the victim before the incident; code age measured from deployment (onchain).
